name: vista_qwen_independent_frozen_candidate_validation_v3
prompt: Please describe this image in detail.
stability_gate: No severe-repetition/language flags; no empty captions; manually inspect all validation captions. Output cap hits and length are diagnostic outcomes, not validity gates.
selection_rule: Candidate lambda=.1, alpha=.03 is frozen before validation: first setting in the original grid with zero repetition/language flags. Preserve both VSV and SLA. This validation group does not select/tune parameters.
source_notes: Official README recommends new-architecture calibration; preserve raw intermediate lm_head projection and source VSV/PCA. No added RMSNorm, repetition penalty, or test-ID tuning.
failure_action: If the frozen candidate fails independent fluency validation, do not run its 500-image evaluation or tune on those test IDs.
validation_role: First 12 IDs in the existing 38-image holdout, disjoint from both development and supplied 500. Validate a frozen candidate; do not select among candidates on this group.
protocol_revision_disclosure: Adaptive development decision after all six original settings failed a cap-count threshold. Five had zero repetition/language flags. A matched maximum length does not require matched realized length; rejecting solely for 3 rather than 2 capped captions was an unjustified validity gate. The original protocol/results remain intact. The 500-image test scores have not been consulted.
